The build enables libx265, libdrm and VAAPI, with shared libraries, GPL, and
Fedora's compiler and linker hardening flags. To inspect the exact configure
line on a candidate generator, run `ffmpeg -version`; the complete output
must match the digest above for an exact-toolchain replay. Otherwise perform
a fresh three-run byte-identity qualification before treating it as
equivalent. The earlier small codec fixtures remain pinned to FFmpeg 8.1.2
and are not regenerated with this toolchain.
